qr_modal.warning: Make sure your wallet populates all the payment details, including the shielded memo content.

console_modal.title: Pay from Kerrigan Core's console
console_modal.lead: In Kerrigan Core, open the console (Window → Console, or Ctrl+Shift+C), paste this command and press Enter. The destination, the amount and the memo are in it already, the memo written in hex, the way the wallet wants it.
console_modal.from: Replace YOUR_ADDRESS with your own address the coins come from - a shielded one (ks1…) or a transparent one (K…).
console_modal.warning: Needs Kerrigan Core v1.4.0 or later: older versions cannot read this command from the console.

onboarding.bullet1_1: Get your personal name john.krgn and use it to receive payments instead of sharing a long cryptographic address
onboarding.bullet1_2: Own and control your names. Hold, trade on marketplace, or transfer to others - only you can make updates
onboarding.bullet2_1: No renewal fees. Your names are always yours!
onboarding.bullet2_2: Names are stored on-chain. Data cannot be altered or removed
onboarding.bullet2_3: Private by design. Your name reveals nothing about your finances.
onboarding.bullet3_1: Update your destination address without notifying senders. They still be sending to john.krgn
onboarding.bullet3_2: Change owner, but only with signing by your private key. Only you can do that!
onboarding.bullet3_3: List on Marketplace and earn for popular names reselling.
